Original contribution
This two-band, one-motor forced oscillator, its retained anchor stacks,
weighted passive balance, real supporting frame, placement ledger, finite
programs, independent dynamics, verification code, lessons and prose were
authored for this add-on. No external model, illustration, prose, program,
noncommercial asset or unlicensed asset was copied from dmg-lib.org or
another mechanism site. DYNAMICS.md derives the equations from the declared
geometry and the unchanged native rubber-band law.

The preceding Cusp Lab supplied the current cumulative catalog and tested
workflow. Its original BSD generic runtime adapters were reused. All
mechanism observations, dynamics, response criteria and motion evidence
are specific to Resonance Lab. Integration baseline hashes are recorded
in integration/baseline.json.

External geometry, referenced only
The pinned application supplies standard LDraw part files and primitives.
They remain external to the BSD source archive and retain their individual
authors and licenses. Construction evidence records the exact mesh hashes.
The model files are original arrangements of references to those parts.
CAD-derived previews are separate and carry the complete recursive notices
for the meshes actually rendered. Mathematical plots in validation/ use
only original measured numerical data and contain no external part mesh.

License boundary
See LICENSE, licenses/resonance-lab.txt and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. The runtime
package manifests and lockfile identify external software; its implementation
and the LDraw library are not bundled in the BSD source ZIP.

Model representation
The two 85546.dat rubber bands are physical parts represented through the
application's ordinary !BW BELT records. A generic LDraw viewer may ignore
those records and show only rigid placements. The qualified Brickwright
importer renders the bands and infers their native spring couplings.
